featured.label: ng-5 · mímisbrunr
featured.title: five-colour / noise *machine*
featured.description: NG-5, model MÍMISBRUNR, is a local-first noise instrument in the spirit of 1970s synths and the TR-909 era: white, pink, brown, blue and violet voices that ring-modulate and convolve each other, a slow breathing tide, and a delta-band pulse with a sleep timer that fades out. It installs as an app on phones and tablets, works offline, and nothing leaves the device. Nine colour themes include three for colour vision differences.

panel.label: what it does
bullets: mixes five noise colours with tone, pan and breathing swell per voice
x-mod, convolution space and drift let the voices alter each other
bakes a seamless tape that keeps playing, and fading, with the screen locked

catalog.name: NG-5 MÍMISBRUNR

White, pink, brown, blue and violet voices ring-modulate and convolve each other over a slow breathing tide, with an optional delta-band pulse and a sleep timer that fades out.
